name: Duvael Lychee-Miso Cream
description: An unusual umami-sweet cream soda combining lychee syrup with a hint of white miso, giving it a savory depth that divides opinion sharply. A niche hit with Tier 3 food culture communities.
flavor_profile: Sweet floral lychee up front, then a quiet savory undercurrent from white miso that lingers. Creamy texture, low carbonation, slightly cloudy appearance.
slogan: Not for everyone. Maybe for you.
cultural_context: Duvael Lychee-Miso Cream is a litmus test drink in Meridian 88's food culture circles — liking it signals a certain palate sophistication (or pretension, depending on who you ask). Food BCI content creators have built entire followings around reaction videos to first-time drinkers encountering the miso finish.
story_hooks: A Tier 4 corponation wants to acquire Duvael's fermentation process — not for the soda, but for the proprietary miso culture the family has maintained for six generations.
A food critic with a massive BCI following is being paid to negatively review Duvael by a competitor, but finds themselves genuinely loving the product and facing a crisis of integrity.

Duvael's fermentation works sits on contested land — a street community has been living in the adjacent building for decades and the family has quietly protected them, but a new legal challenge threatens both.
